title: Emotional identification
learning_outcomes: Explain emotion labels in the context of emotional identification.
Compare and distinguish event and interpretation in the context of emotional identification.
Apply needs in the context of emotional identification.
Evaluate and justify decisions about response choices in the context of emotional identification.

lessons.title: Emotion labels
lessons.outcome: Explain emotion labels in the context of emotional identification.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving emotion labels; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional emotion map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain emotion labels from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of emotion labels; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Event and interpretation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish event and interpretation in the context of emotional identification.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving event and interpretation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional emotion map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain event and interpretation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of event and interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Needs
lessons.outcome: Apply needs in the context of emotional identification.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving needs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional emotion map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain needs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Response choices
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about response choices in the context of emotional identification.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving response choices; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional emotion map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain response choices from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of response choices; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of emotion labels; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of event and interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of response choices; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
